articles.titleEn: Dumplings: A Folded Little Packet of Luck
articles.deckZh: 饺子不只是食物，它还会带来好运、团圆和冬天里热腾腾的故事。
articles.deckEn: Dumplings carry more than filling. They carry luck, family time, and warm winter memory.

summary.zh: 饺子里可以藏硬币，过年和冬至时常常会上桌。更重要的是，一家人常常要围在一起擀皮、拌馅、包饺子，所以饺子也是一种团圆的动作。
summary.en: A dumpling can hide a lucky coin, appear at New Year or winter meals, and gather a whole family around the table to make it together.

images.alt: A plate of Chinese dumplings arranged in a warm storybook-style illustration.
images.captionZh: 一盘热腾腾的饺子，看起来像一个个小元宝。
images.captionEn: A warm plate of dumplings that look a little like tiny ingots.
images.brief: 主视觉。聚焦一盘刚出锅的饺子，暖色调、近景、让孩子一眼看懂“这是今天的主角”。

images.alt: A family making dumplings together at the table before a New Year meal.
images.captionZh: 包饺子的过程本身，就是全家一起做事、一起说笑的时间。
images.captionEn: Making dumplings together turns dinner into family time.
images.brief: 家庭场景。多代同堂或亲子一起包饺子，重点是协作和团圆，不是节日装饰堆砌。
